name: pg-management
description: Paying Guest accommodation management platform for owners, residents and administrators

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:start && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
